title: Analyzing and Mitigating Poisoning Attacks on Flow-Based Intrusion Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.19766v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Although Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based Intrusion Detection Systems (IDSs) are increasingly deployed in operational networks, their dependence on large-scale training data introduces a critical vulnerability to stealthy poisoning attacks. We demonstrate that latent backdoors can be successfully implanted in flow-based IDS models by poisoning as little as 0.001% of the training data, maintaining near-nominal performance on clean inputs while ensuring high attack success rates. To address this threat, we propose a diagnostic-first methodology that localizes trigger-relevant features through constrained perturbation analysis and detects poisoning-induced behavioral drift by comparison with a distilled baseline model. The proposed methodology further enables targeted mitigation via automated data sanitization or neuron pruning. translated_title: 针对基于流的入侵检测中投毒攻击的分析与缓解
translated_abstract: 尽管基于人工智能（AI）的入侵检测系统（IDS）在运营网络中的部署日益增多，但其对大规模训练数据的依赖使其面临隐蔽投毒攻击的严重漏洞。我们证明，仅需污染0.001%的训练数据，就能在基于流的IDS模型中成功植入潜在后门，在保持对干净输入接近正常性能的同时确保高攻击成功率。为应对这一威胁，我们提出了一种“诊断优先”的方法论，通过受限扰动分析定位触发器相关特征，并通过与蒸馏基线模型的对比检测投毒引起的行为漂移。该方法进一步支持通过自动化数据清洗或神经元剪枝实现针对性缓解。我们的发现揭示了几乎无法检测的后门所带来的运营风险，并提供了一种可扩展的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了仅需污染0.001%训练数据即可在基于流的入侵检测系统中植入隐蔽后门，并提出一种诊断优先的方法，通过受限扰动分析定位触发特征、借助蒸馏基线模型检测行为漂移，并结合自动化数据清洗或神经元剪枝实现针对性缓解。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that poisoning as little as 0.001% of training data can implant stealthy backdoors in flow-based IDS models, and proposes a diagnostic-first methodology that localizes trigger-relevant features via constrained perturbation analysis, detects poisoning-induced behavioral drift against a distilled baseline, and enables targeted mitigation through automated data sanitization or neuron pruning.
